other_conditions: Applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board
Benefit is available for up to one girl child per family
Application must be made within 12 months from the birth of the girl child
benefits_summary: A bond of ₹25,000 (or as revised) is issued for the first girl child up to age 1, maturing at 18 years and payable to the daughter.
